chapters.d: While enjoying coffee overlooking Marsamxett Harbour, you check Telegram for an automated briefing prepared by your nocturnal research bot. It has already parsed regulatory gazettes and compiled vessel status reports into Notion.

Your team of specialist bots coordinates in a dedicated Telegram group to verify corporate registries across the EU. One bot navigates portals with its autonomous browser while another verifies VAT numbers and updates Google Sheets.

A client needs a landing page updated for an upcoming Mediterranean iGaming summit. Your coding agent writes, runs, and tests the code in its isolated cloud environment, delivering a staged preview in minutes.

As you step out into Valletta for dinner, your cloud computers keep executing code and balancing routines uninterrupted. Whether your phone is switched off or disconnected, scheduled tasks run without missing a beat.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost in Malta and is there a trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every subscription starts with a 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens daily; your payment card is linked upon registration and only charged once the trial ends unless cancelled beforehand.

faq.q: Can Ceyo agents interact with local businesses and international clients in different languages?
faq.a: Yes, Ceyo bots communicate fluently in English, Maltese, Italian, and dozens of other global languages. They can conduct autonomous web research, hold voice calls, and draft comprehensive reports tailored to multilingual European and Mediterranean markets.

faq.q: Do Ceyo bots run on my computer or in the cloud?
faq.a: Every Ceyo agent operates within its own dedicated, isolated cloud computer. It keeps browsing, running scripts, and monitoring web data 24/7 without consuming your battery or bandwidth, even when your phone or laptop is completely turned off.

faq.q: How do teams in Malta collaborate with Ceyo over Telegram?
faq.a: You can create personal Telegram bots or invite multiple Ceyo agents into group chats where they function as a coordinated team. You can assign specific tasks, trigger workflows, and review collective research summaries directly inside your daily messaging app.

faq.q: Which business applications can Ceyo integrate with?
faq.a: Ceyo connects seamlessly to over 1,000 tools, including Gmail, Slack, Google Sheets, Notion, calendars, and major CRMs. It also features a built-in crypto wallet and an autonomous web browser to interact with platforms lacking standard APIs.
